Venue asks: written confirmation that Pimienta is welcome, plus the pet policy, restrictions in the chapel, grove, cellar and dining areas, and a place for him to wait with water.
Venue asks: chapel audio (PA, hearing loop, who supplies mics); early access for a sound check and interpreter rehearsal; step-free access to the front row.

Timing rule: if the ceremony starts late, shorten the cocktails, never the ceremony. Dinner stays at 19:30. Ask the caterer and DJ to be flexible on cocktail length.
Budget: hard cap EUR 42,000 all in. If the total runs over, cut fireworks first and keep the interpreter. Any fireworks booking must be cancellable.

Open items for Itzel: correct year, RSVP count (Finnish family), whether a photographer is chosen, ceremony length, who handles Pimienta, whether fireworks are planned, and the budget breakdown so far.
